bill.constitutionalAuthorityStatementText:
[Congressional Record Volume 169, Number 71 (Thursday, April 27, 2023)]
[House]
[Pages H2085-H2086]
From the Congressional Record Online through the Government Publishing Office [www.gpo.gov]
By Mr. AMODEI:
H.R. 2925.
Congress has the power to enact this legislation pursuant
to the following:
The constitutional authority on which this bill rests is
the power of Congress to make
[[Page H2086]]
all rules and regulations respecting property belonging to
the United States under Article IV, Section 3, Clause 2.
The single subject of this legislation is:
This bill provides clarity that the ancillary uses (support
facilities, tailings, etc) inherently accompany exploration
and extraction activities for other mining-support
activities.
